calculation.description: Ranks assets contrarian to their 60-day return, with stronger reversal preference for assets whose preceding move was persistent. Higher values indicate stronger expected 20-day forward return under the validated reversal regime. All inputs are lagged through decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history gate is passed narrowly on ICIR. The factor is strongly positive in recent, online, and 2028 regimes (reversal IC 0.107071 recent, 0.157219 online, 0.123213 in 2028), but small 15-asset cross-section implies uncertainty. Validate drift before increasing allocation.
validation.audit: Spearman cross-sectional daily IC; forward returns use close at t+20 and signal uses data through t only. 2,963 dates, 15 instruments, minimum 8 valid names.
